GeneratedBy.Description: ISIS MER .dat files (int16, 20 kHz; not released) decoded, overflow-corrected, band-passed 500-5000 Hz (4th-order Butterworth, causal lfilter) and clipped to +-500 instrument units; a Random Forest signal-quality classifier on 0.5 s windows then kept, per recording, the longest continuous fragment with >= 3 consecutive 'Neuronal activity' windows (>= 1.5 s) or else the longest artefact-free fragment >= 2 s; an electrophysiologist annotated 29 excerpts (striatum/putamen, GPe, GPi).
